authority: User-approved default interaction rules and response annotations, 2026-11-06; additive interaction policy, not a semantic schema or ABI freeze

owners.native_keys: existing Web and Windows text input adapters

required_changes: Keep Demo round brush and SDK initial brush defaults unchanged
Successful local Shape/line/arrow creation selects the created object in point selection mode
Text click uses default 320 world-unit wrap width; drag previews a dashed box and creates a width-sized editor on release; height is automatic
Dragging cancels without canonical mutation; empty text remains a draft until input
Successful local Sticky creation opens its existing shared text editor; Table creation opens its first cell
Enter inserts a paragraph, Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter finishes; beforeinput line breaks also insert paragraphs
Successful text finish selects the user-facing object in point mode; pending/failed composition must not switch tools
Native composition Enter stays owned by the input method
Normal image import explicitly resets selection acquisition to point
Restore, remote operations and undo/redo do not run local creation focus policy
forbidden_changes: New public API, DTO, ABI, semantic format or dependency lock changes
Shell-owned selection, history, identity or text lifecycle
Published dependency rebuilds, publication or version bump

required: Native shared text lifecycle tests: immediate and composition-delayed finish, failed composition, empty draft, selection-root behavior
Real Chrome copied root SDK: creation selection, click/drag/cancel text, Enter/Ctrl/Cmd finish, Sticky/Table initial edit, lasso-to-point image import, dashed pixels and read-only drag preview
Affected native composition/text/selection and rendering regressions
Existing Chrome table and public SDK consumer regressions

blocking: Local native and Chrome results under out/default-interaction-*; matching built JS/WASM/resources
corroborative: Interactive Web Demo at local HTTP URL; physical IME testing remains a separate user exercise

all_of: Demo rebuilt and served for user testing
Report exact changes and platform verification limits
